learn: Exploit broken object level authorization (BOLA) in a REST API by hand
Discover endpoints with Postman/Burp and tamper with request bodies
Weak spots of JWT-based session handling
How the OWASP API Security Top 10 shows up in a small application

vulns.name: BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization)
vulns.desc: Read another user's books/data by changing an ID

vulns.name: Mass Assignment
vulns.desc: Escalate privileges by adding admin=true to the registration request

vulns.name: SQL Injection
vulns.desc: Query manipulation in the book search endpoint

vulns.name: User Enumeration
vulns.desc: Find usernames from differences in error messages

vulns.name: Excessive Data Exposure
vulns.desc: A debug endpoint leaks passwords and user data

vulns.name: Weak JWT Key
vulns.desc: Forge tokens with a guessable signing key

vulns.name: Missing Rate Limiting
vulns.desc: Unlimited attempts for password guessing and resource exhaustion

learn: How GraphQL is structured: schema, queries, mutations and introspection
GraphQL-specific attacks: batching, aliases and deep-query DoS
Injection and server-side command execution through mutations
Discovery with GraphQL IDEs and Burp extensions

vulns.name: Introspection Enabled
vulns.desc: Query the whole schema and find hidden fields

vulns.name: Brute Force via Batching
vulns.desc: Hundreds of login/OTP attempts in a single request

vulns.name: Deep / Circular Query (DoS)
vulns.desc: Exhaust the server with nested relationships

vulns.name: OS Command Injection
vulns.desc: Command execution in mutations such as importPaste

vulns.name: Stored XSS
vulns.desc: Scripts in content saved through GraphQL

vulns.name: IDOR
vulns.desc: Fetch someone else's data by changing an ID

vulns.name: JWT / Authorization Flaws
vulns.desc: Missing field-level authorization checks
